figures: 1. Figure 1: Comparison of intervention policies in terms of relative improvement in acute events (blue) and fairness disparity reduction (orange), both expressed as percentages relative to the risk-based baseline. Error bars indicate 95% bootstrap confidence intervals. The unified scale facilitates visual comparison across metrics. FCAF-RL achieves the largest improvements on both objectives.
results_section: 1. FCAF-RL achieved a 21% reduction in acute events relative to IQL.
2. Off-policy evaluation confirmed significantly higher expected return for FCAF-RL versus all baselines (p < 0.01).
3. Inference time for a new patient is approximately 0.2 seconds.
